title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning
authors: X. Wang, J. Wei, D. Schuurmans, Q. Le, E. Chi, S. Narang, A. Chowdhery, D. Zhou
before: Chain of thought produced one reasoning path, decoded greedily.
problem: A single path fails if any step goes wrong, and greedy decoding is arbitrary.
breakthrough: Sample many reasoning paths and take the most common final answer.
why: The cleanest demonstration that extra inference compute converts directly into accuracy.
next: Tree of thoughts, verifier-guided search, and the reasoning models of 2024.
inherits: Majority voting over samples, still a standard evaluation trick.
